newsitem.title: UK: Carlton sees strong outlook for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Carlton sees strong outlook for 1997.

text.p: Britain's Carlton Communications Plc said on Wednesday its revenue from television advertising grew strongly in the first quarter and it saw a positive performance outlook for the whole of 1997.
Carlton's chairman Michael Green told shareholders at its annual general meeting that it would further strengthen its production base and expand its subscription network.
"This year we will be producing some 400 hours for ITV and a further 350 hours for other terrestrial, cable and satellite channels," he said.
Green said the company was also satisfied with the recent integration of Westcountry Television with its television.
Carlton recently set up a joint venture, British Digital Broadcasting Plc, with BSkyB Plc and Granada Group Plc seeking to operate digital terrestrial tv services.
